name: homelab
description: Homelab: keeps live addresses filled with your Proxmox VE VMs and containers and Docker containers, by tag, label or name

proxmox_url.description: Proxmox VE API, such as https://pve.lan:8006 (empty = no Proxmox)

proxmox_token_id.description: API token ID, such as goblin@pve!gate (read-only: VM.Audit, plus VM.GuestAgent.Audit or VM.Monitor for VM addresses)

proxmox_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the Proxmox certificate (for its self-signed one), as the node's Certificates page shows it

proxmox_ca.description: or: the CA certificate (PEM) that signed it; with neither, the system's CAs

docker_url.description: Docker API over TLS, such as tcp://docker.lan:2376 (empty = no Docker)

docker_cert.description: a client certificate (PEM) that CA signed

docker_host_address.description: the Docker host's LAN address, used for containers behind its NAT (empty = from docker_url)

name_patterns.description: object=pattern, such as web=web-*: guests whose name matches go into that object, next to the gg-<object> tags and labels

networks.description: use only addresses in these networks, such as 192.168.20.0/24 (empty = all but loopback and link-local)

interval_seconds.description: how often the guests are read
